description: Telegram workspace M1 per DESIGN §14 (CR-003): component kit and typed Bot API 10.1-10.3 adapter, topics and flat mode, menu scopes, pinned dashboard, routing table, the review flow S1-S12 (PR title never cut), the CR-004 presentation (proposal cards, size line, rescope and ceiling cards, /work and link cards, /size, /filters), the full command set with pickers (CR-001 lifecycle, CR-002 /egress, /hermes tier, /skills and the skill card, /model and the new-model card), notifications and offline states. Depends on FEAT-005..008. Plan: docs/PLAN.md (Telegram workspace M1 (DESIGN §14; CR-003 with CR-001, CR-002 and CR-004 controls)). Requirement rows: docs/TRACEABILITY.md.
steps: Item 44: Kit and plumbing (§14.18, §14.10, §14.17; rows DES-AC-14, DES-V-20, DES-V-32, ADR-0004, ADR-0020b, CR2-7b, TGRW-10, TGRW-11, TGRW-13, TGRW-14, TGRW-15, CR3-M1, CR3-D1, CR3-D2, CR3-D3, CR3-D12, CR3-D13, CR3-D16, CR3-U1, CR3-U2, CR3-U6, CR3-U8, CR3-AC-1, CR3-AC-2, CR3-AC-3, CR3-AC-12, CR3-AC-13, CR3-AC-14, CR3-AC-25, CR3-AC-26, CR3-AC-37, CR3-BA-6, CR3-BA-7, CR3-V-1, CR3-V-4, CR3-V-12, CR3-V-14, CR3-V-15). `telegram/ui/{kit,blocks,classic,rich,sanitize,limits,icons,send}.py`, `telegram/rawapi.py` (typed 10.1–10.3 payloads over `do_api_request`), `escape.defuse_commands`/`sanitize.undefuse`, `config/telegram.yaml` + schema via the snapshot, topics with flat fallback, menu button and per-state command scopes, the pinned dashboard, `telegram/routing.py` (normative routing table; non-command updates to the chat backend; GitHub links to link cards), import-linter contracts of §14.20.1. Migration `0005_telegram_ux.sql` (§14.20.2: `tg_topics`, `pending_input` with the full kind set, `review_comments`, `change_requests.comments_json`, the `tg_outbox` priority/thread/coalesce/merge columns, `ux_prefs`) and `telegram/pending_input.py` (15 min TTL, matched only by `reply_to_message.message_id`, single consumption). The Phase 1 docstrings that cite DESIGN §14.1–§14.5 are pointed at the current sections (TGRW-15).

Item 45: Review flow S1–S12 (§14.11.1–§14.11.14; rows DES-FR-5, DES-AC-14, ADR-0019, TGRW-12, CR3-D4, CR3-D5, CR3-D6, CR3-D7, CR3-U3, CR3-U4, CR3-AC-4, CR3-AC-5, CR3-AC-6, CR3-AC-7, CR3-AC-8, CR3-AC-9, CR3-AC-10, CR3-AC-11, CR3-AC-23, CR3-AC-30, CR3-AC-32, CR3-AC-44, CR3-AC-45, CR3-AC-52, CR3-AC-53, CR3-AC-56, CR3-AC-60, CR3-BA-11, CR3-BA-13, CR3-F6-1, CR3-F6-6, CR3-V-5, CR3-V-6). Decorated S1 per kind with the size line and `👤` marker, explorer, file views and diffs, `.patch` and HTML diff documents, comments and the draft review (`review_comments`), interdiff (S6) with `/package` interdiff, S7 edit title/body/comment (policy check first), S8 approve/confirm (`confirm_text`), S9 submitted, S12 stale, `/queue` ordering; the PR title is never cut (256-char test) and mockups 01/03 are updated to show the full title; copy-title length check. Carried detail (reconciled with DESIGN revision 5; the item text above wins): telegram/pending_input.py over the pending_input table of item 44 (0005_telegram_ux.sql): created when a ForceReply prompt is sent, 15 min TTL, matched only by reply_to_message.message_id == prompt_message_id in the owner chat, single consumption. Request changes -> ForceReply 'Describe the change (<= 4000 chars)' -> change_requests row (with comments_json from the draft review) + AWAITING_APPROVAL->CHANGES_REQUESTED via state_machine -> the card goes to S5 and later S12. S7 Edit text (title, body, edit_comment for comment/claim bodies) -> ForceReply with the current text quoted -> policy.check_text with the gatekeeper secret values before ApprovalService.set_text_override stores anything (P1-4 service side is item 25) -> new card, old approval invalidated; Clear my edits sits behind Edit text. Reject -> reasons [Not valuable] [Wrong approach] [Repo unsuitable (7d)] [Other…]; Other -> ForceReply (<= 500 chars); Repo unsuitable -> repo_overrides.cooldown_until = now + 7 d. Give up on this fix / Stop watching (+ confirm) per §9.12. Tests: tests/telegram/test_pending_input.py, tests/telegram/test_edit_flows.py (an edited body with a confidentiality-floor value or without the disclosure is refused and nothing is stored; an edited title with a newline is refused; a wrong reply target, an expired prompt and a replayed token change nothing).

Item 46: CR-004 presentation (§14.11.15–§14.11.19, §14.14.4; rows DES-FR-20, DES-AC-37, DES-AC-38, DES-AC-39, DES-AC-40, DES-AC-41, CR3-D18, CR3-D19, CR3-D22, CR3-U13, CR3-AC-38, CR3-AC-39, CR3-AC-40, CR3-AC-41, CR3-AC-43, CR3-AC-50, CR3-AC-51, CR3-AC-54, CR3-AC-61, CR3-AC-62, CR3-AC-63, CR3-BA-8, CR3-BA-12, CR4-1e, CR4-2b, CR4-2i, CR4-2k, CR4-2l, CHAT-27, CHAT-29, CHAT-30). Proposal card and versions with the deterministic diff, decline and Undo, RESCOPE and ceiling cards, `/work` and link cards with notes, `/size` (`xs`…`xl`, per-repo `inherit`, ceiling read-only), `/filters` (4 pages).

Item 47: Controls, notifications and states (§14.13, §14.14, §14.15, §14.16; rows DES-FR-6, DES-FR-17, DES-AC-13 (/model part), DES-AC-31, DES-AC-35, CR1-5c, CR2-2a, CR2-3a, CR2-3d, CR2-7k, CHAT-12, CHAT-25, TGRW-14, CR3-D11, CR3-D14, CR3-D15, CR3-U7, CR3-AC-16, CR3-AC-17, CR3-AC-21, CR3-AC-33, CR3-AC-34, CR3-AC-49, CR3-F6-5). The full §14.14.1 command set with pickers and confirmation patterns (`/drain /undrain /down /up`, `/egress`, `/hermes tier`, `/skills` + skill card, `/model` + new-model card, `/reload`, `/repos`, `/limits`, `/logs`, `/settings`, `/quiet`, `/notify`, `/new`), priorities P0–P3, quiet hours, coalescing and batching (never for rows with buttons), offline and killed states, short-description updates. Carried detail (reconciled with DESIGN revision 5; the item text above wins): commands in telegram/commands/{review.py,admin.py,lifecycle.py} next to builtin.py. /queue (ranked pager, gate 2 before gate 1, [Open n] keeps each item's expiry); /approve [cid] = AppContext.reissue(cid, actor, keep_expiry=True) with the eligibility answers of §14.18.4.3 (never the revision-4 'fresh approval row on expiry' semantics); /reject, /reload (diff then confirm), /repos (Enable/Disable/Allow AI write repo_overrides after confirm; the size row is item 46), /limits and /budget, /logs (last 40 redacted lines plus the log as a document), /new and /newchat (topic mode: a new topic; flat mode: chat_sessions.n += 1, table from item 37). CR-001 /drain (immediate), /undrain (confirm), /down (timeout picker + confirm) and /up (confirm, refused while killed) call the lifecycle API; the root helper and its path unit are item 42 and are not rebuilt here. /model and the new-model card call the item 28 writer; /egress and /hermes tier call the item 23 and item 36 routes; /skills and the skill card use SkillApprovals (item 24). setMyCommands per scope and control state from registry.menu(). Tests: tests/telegram/test_commands.py (every command; go/config never act without the confirm tap; /approve keeps the expiry), tests/telegram/test_model_command.py, and tests/system/test_lifecycle.sh extended with the Telegram path (runner, hermes and sandboxd stopped, gatekeeper still active, then up).

Item 48: Close-out FEAT-009: redeploy, `DEV pytest -m "unit or telegram"`, live owner-only checks (topics created, dashboard pinned, a dry-run proposal and preview card from the fake upstream rendered in the real chat), TRACEABILITY and VERIFICATION updated, commit.
acceptance_criteria: DEV pytest -m "unit or telegram" passes for every DESIGN §14.21 AC and BA assigned to FEAT-009 in docs/TRACEABILITY.md, incl. budgets over all View builders (AC 1), no untrusted rich html/markdown (AC 2), Approve only on the card (AC 4), per-kind purposes (AC 5), stale cards (AC 10), queue order (AC 11), topics (AC 12), menu scopes (AC 13), dashboard (AC 14)
The PR title is shown in full on every card (256-char test asserts exact bytes and the approval hash); mockups 01 and 03 show the full title; copy title checks its length

CR-004 presentation: proposal card, versions with diff, decline and Undo, size line with the overrun formula, RESCOPE and ceiling cards, /work and link cards, /size (never xxl, ceiling read-only) and /filters (4 pages) behave as §14.21 AC 38-41, 43, 50, 51, 54, 61-63

Every §14.14.1 command exists with its picker and safety class; go/config commands act only after the confirm tap; /egress, /hermes tier and skill activation are two-tap; P0 is never silenced; batching never holds a message with buttons
Live owner-only checks: topics created once, dashboard pinned, a dry-run proposal card and preview card from the fake upstream rendered in the real chat; recorded in docs/VERIFICATION.md
Import-linter contracts of §14.20.1 hold; ruff, mypy, lint-imports clean; TRACEABILITY rows updated; git status --porcelain empty after the commit
